title: Ebay Has to Pay $55.7 Million in Settlement for Its Unhinged Harassment Campaign
summary: The Steiners will receive more than $46.15 million from eBay, $2 million from former eBay CEO Devin Wenig, $500,000 from former eBay executive Wendy Jones, and $50,000 from former eBay executive Steve Wymer.
